title: Settings
posViewModeDesc: Choose how products are displayed on the POS screen
productsPerRowDesc: Number of product columns displayed in grid view
pharmacyNameDesc: The display name shown on invoices and receipts
pharmacyNameArDesc: Arabic version used for bilingual documents
taxPercentDesc: Default tax rate applied to sales
currencyDesc: ISO currency code (e.g. USD, EGP, SAR)
pricingModeDesc: How selling prices are determined across the system
allowBelowCostDesc: What happens when a sale price is lower than cost
defaultMarginDesc: Percentage margin added on top of cost price
pharmacyPhoneDesc: Pharmacy contact number shown on receipts
receiptHeaderDesc: Custom text shown below the pharmacy name on receipts
receiptFooterDesc: Text shown at the bottom of receipts
receiptShowLogoDesc: Display pharmacy logo on printed receipts
receiptAutoPrintDesc: Automatically print receipt when a sale completes
receiptPrintCopiesDesc: Number of receipt copies to print per sale
